title: Link Resource Cache
description: Resource cache reads (Acquisition Worker, Normalization, MeasureEval) and .NET durable writes.

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.description: deployment.environment.name, from Telemetry:DeploymentEnvironment. Single-select: a hit ratio or quantile across environments means nothing.

options.content: All three readers record `link_resource_cache_read_duration` under the same name and tags, so these panels group by service rather than repeating per service. `DataAcquisitionWorker` and `Normalization` are .NET; `measureeval` is Java and also tags `phase`, which every query here aggregates away. Counts of rare events treat a series that did not exist yet as zero, because `increase()` reads a newly created series' first observations as no change. See `docs-dev/resource-cache.md`, *Instrumentation*.

panels.title: Hit ratio
panels.description: Hits over hits plus fallbacks, for the selected time range. `empty` reads are left out: nothing held the key in either store, so Redis could not have served them (the Acquisition Worker's Encounter probe produces one per correlation by design).

targets.expr: sum by (exported_job) ((clamp_min(max_over_time(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="hit"}[$__range]) - (link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="hit"} offset $__range or max_over_time(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="hit"}[$__range]) * 0), 0) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})) / sum by (exported_job) ((clamp_min(max_over_time(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome=~"hit|fallback"}[$__range]) - (link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome=~"hit|fallback"} offset $__range or max_over_time(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome=~"hit|fallback"}[$__range]) * 0), 0) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}))

panels.title: Hit ratio over time
panels.description: The same ratio as the stat, per scrape window. A dip means reads are going to blob storage: see the fallback panel for why.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_job) ((rate(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="hit"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})) / sum by (exported_job) ((rate(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome=~"hit|fallback"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}))

panels.title: Untrusted empty reads
panels.description: `empty` + `unavailable`: Redis could not be asked and blob storage held nothing, so the caller got an empty answer nobody should trust. The first alert candidate. Should be zero.

targets.expr: sum((clamp_min(max_over_time(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="empty",cache_fallback_reason="unavailable"}[$__range]) - (link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="empty",cache_fallback_reason="unavailable"} offset $__range or max_over_time(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="empty",cache_fallback_reason="unavailable"}[$__range]) * 0), 0) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Partial entries
panels.description: Reads that found an incomplete Redis entry (fewer keys than the durable count says were written) and fell back to blob. Non-zero means entries are being recreated after eviction.

targets.expr: sum((clamp_min(max_over_time(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_fallback_reason="partial"}[$__range]) - (link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_fallback_reason="partial"} offset $__range or max_over_time(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_fallback_reason="partial"}[$__range]) * 0), 0) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Reads without the partial-entry check
panels.description: `durable_count_read_failure_count`: the durable count was unreadable, so an entry was served without checking it was whole. Should be zero. A counter that was never incremented is not exported at all, so no series here is the healthy state.

targets.expr: sum((clamp_min(max_over_time(link_resource_cache_durable_count_read_failure_count_total{exported_job=~"$service"}[$__range]) - (link_resource_cache_durable_count_read_failure_count_total{exported_job=~"$service"} offset $__range or max_over_time(link_resource_cache_durable_count_read_failure_count_total{exported_job=~"$service"}[$__range]) * 0), 0) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Writes that exhausted retries
panels.description: Durable writes abandoned after the last retry (.NET writers only). `interrupted` is a shutdown draining the queue and is excluded. Should be zero.

targets.expr: sum((clamp_min(max_over_time(link_resource_cache_write_retry_count_total{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="exhausted"}[$__range]) - (link_resource_cache_write_retry_count_total{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="exhausted"} offset $__range or max_over_time(link_resource_cache_write_retry_count_total{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="exhausted"}[$__range]) * 0), 0) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Reads per second by outcome
panels.description: Every read, by service and outcome.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_job, cache_outcome) ((rate(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}))

panels.title: Fallback reads by reason
panels.description: Reads served from blob storage. `miss`: Redis did not have the key. `partial`: Redis had an incomplete entry. `unavailable`: Redis could not be reached.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_job, cache_fallback_reason) ((clamp_min(max_over_time(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="fallback"}[$__interval]) - (link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="fallback"} offset $__interval or max_over_time(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="fallback"}[$__interval]) * 0), 0) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}))

panels.title: Empty reads by reason
panels.description: Reads where neither store held the key. `DataAcquisitionWorker` · `miss` at about one per correlation is expected: `LocationMappingService` probes `{correlationId}:Encounter` and treats nothing cached as nothing to resolve. Do not alert on `empty` alone. `unavailable` is the one that matters.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_job, cache_fallback_reason) ((clamp_min(max_over_time(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="empty"}[$__interval]) - (link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="empty"} offset $__interval or max_over_time(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="empty"}[$__interval]) * 0), 0) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}))

panels.title: Read duration by service
panels.description: p50 and p95 across every outcome.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_job) ((rate(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_job=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, exported_job) ((rate(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_job=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})))

panels.title: Read duration p95 by outcome
panels.description: What a fallback costs against a hit.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_job, cache_outcome) ((rate(link_resource_cache_read_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_job=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})))

options.content: MeasureEval never writes the cache, so expect only `DataAcquisitionWorker` and `Normalization` here.

panels.title: Drain wait
panels.description: Time spent waiting for queued durable writes to finish before the work is advertised downstream. The only part of the blob write not overlapped with other work: the honest cost of durability.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_job) ((rate(link_resource_cache_drain_wait_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_job=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, exported_job) ((rate(link_resource_cache_drain_wait_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_job=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})))

panels.title: Durable write queue depth
panels.description: Writes queued for blob storage. A depth that keeps climbing means durable storage is not keeping up.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_job) (link_resource_cache_queue_depth{exported_job=~"$service"} * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})

panels.title: Queue wait
panels.description: Time a write sat in the queue before a worker picked it up: a backlog, as distinct from storage having slowed down.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_job) ((rate(link_resource_cache_queue_wait_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_job=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, exported_job) ((rate(link_resource_cache_queue_wait_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_job=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})))

panels.title: Write duration p95 by store
panels.description: Inline Redis cost against background blob cost.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_job, cache_store) ((rate(link_resource_cache_write_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_job=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})))

sum by (exported_job, cache_store) ((clamp_min(max_over_time(link_resource_cache_write_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="failed"}[$__interval]) - (link_resource_cache_write_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="failed"} offset $__interval or max_over_time(link_resource_cache_write_duration_milliseconds_count{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome="failed"}[$__interval]) * 0), 0) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}))

panels.title: Write retries by outcome
panels.description: `retried` and `exhausted` only. `interrupted` is a shutdown draining the queue, not storage misbehaving, and is left out.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_job, cache_outcome) ((clamp_min(max_over_time(link_resource_cache_write_retry_count_total{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome!="interrupted"}[$__interval]) - (link_resource_cache_write_retry_count_total{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome!="interrupted"} offset $__interval or max_over_time(link_resource_cache_write_retry_count_total{exported_job=~"$service",cache_outcome!="interrupted"}[$__interval]) * 0), 0) * on (exported_job, exported_instance) group_left() target_info{deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}))
